Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator mis-specified the logical expressions in the Python script, incorrectly mapping the ambiguous textual statements to propositional formulas. This led to evaluating the wrong equivalences (e.g., pairing (¬A ∨ B) with (¬B ∨ ¬A) and (A ∨ ¬B)), producing multiple false pairs and then selecting the first false result as the outlier. As a result, the workflow identified the third statement instead of the correct non-equivalent ( A   B)   (A    B).
